evals.prompt: I want to build a Greek schools directory — a website that lists all public and private primary and secondary schools in Greece with key info: location, type (public/private), contact details, and eventually parent ratings. Greece has no good central directory for this. I already have a dataset of ~14,000 schools scraped from the Ministry of Education website. I have a background in web dev and I'm Greek so I understand the market. Should I build this?
evals.expected_output: A complete evaluation with: (1) business model classified as 'directory', (2) 12 criteria scored with evidence containing real data from CLI tools (subreddit subscriber counts, domain ages, Tranco ranks), (3) a verdict of BUILD (score ~55-70%), (4) scored card saved to ideas/greek-schools-directory/scored-card-v*.md, (5) Business Foundation section present, (6) ranking updated.

assertions.name: verdict_present
assertions.description: Output contains a verdict: one of BET, BUILD, PIVOT, or KILL

assertions.name: business_model_classified_as_directory
assertions.description: Business model is classified as 'directory' (not ecommerce, saas, etc.)

assertions.name: twelve_criteria_scored
assertions.description: Output shows all 12 scoring criteria with scores

assertions.name: scored_card_saved_to_vault
assertions.description: Scored card file exists at ideas/greek-schools-directory/

assertions.name: competitor_section_present
assertions.description: Output includes a competitor landscape section

assertions.name: real_data_evidence
assertions.description: Scored card evidence column contains specific numbers from CLI research (subscriber counts, Tranco ranks, domain ages, trend data) — not just qualitative estimates

evals.prompt: I'm thinking about building a Greek salary calculator — a free tool where people in Greece can enter their job title, years of experience, and city, and see what the market rate is for their salary. Greece has a very opaque salary market and people don't know if they're underpaid. I'd monetize through ads and maybe a premium 'get personalized salary report' feature. I have some data from job boards. Is this worth pursuing?
